Synopsis:
    Russian air strikes on Kyiv and surrounding regions killed nine people on the sixth consecutive day of attacks on the Ukrainian capital. Russia also struck border crossings into Romania and energy infrastructure in Russia's northwest (Ust-Luga port). Peace diplomacy is ongoing, with Zelenskiy engaging Trump envoys Witkoff and Kushner. NATO allies bordering Russia are on heightened alert, activating fighter jets and restricting airspace. The conflict shows no sign of imminent resolution.
